readings: Reset has priority: when reset=1 and slowena=1, q becomes 0 on the next clock edge.
Slowena has priority: when reset=1 and slowena=1, the counter increments (or wraps) instead of resetting to 0.
q[3] is MSB and q[0] is LSB (standard binary representation).
q[0] is MSB and q[3] is LSB, reversing the bit significance.
The counter's initial state before any reset is undefined (X or random).
The counter initializes to 0 at power-up even without an explicit reset.
